jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Go
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager, Go

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is building the AI-native future of work: a family of products people and companies rely on to think, write, and get things done faster, and we're looking for a Technical Program Manager to help shape what Superhuman Go becomes. You'd be joining a team that's rethinking what proactive AI can look like in practice. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and product management teams, shipping software that meaningfully anticipates and amplifies human productivity at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive engineering delivery end-to-end. You'll support the program management of multi-quarter engineering initiatives from planning through launch. That means working closely with engineering teams to track milestones, surface dependencies, and manage technical risks as they come up.

  • Translate engineering requirements into plans people can actually execute. You'll partner with engineering leads to break down technical work into phased delivery plans with clear milestones — identifying the critical path, spotting dependencies, and flagging resource constraints before they become problems. The goal is to give teams the clarity they need to make confident, autonomous decisions.

  • Get into the technical detail. You'll engage directly with engineers on architecture decisions, trade-offs, and system design. You do need to understand what's being built and why, so you can help the team make smart calls about scope, quality, and when something is ready to ship.

  • Track and improve engineering health. You'll keep an eye on delivery metrics, flag risks early, and run post-launch retrospectives to capture what you've learned. You'll work with engineering and data teams to establish the signals that tell you whether a system is doing what it should — and act quickly when it isn't.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in a fast-scaling tech environment. You're either coming from a technical background (Software Engineering, , QA, Data Engineering, or similar) and stepping into program management, or you've been a Program Manager before and want to go deeper on the engineering side.

  • Enough technical depth to earn engineering trust. You understand how software systems are built — whether from hands-on experience writing code, working in data infrastructure, or spending real time embedded with engineering teams.

  • Strong programme management fundamentals, or the drive to build them. You understand (or are genuinely eager to learn) how to run a delivery cadence: planning cycles, dependency tracking, risk management, and keeping stakeholders in the loop. If you're coming from a pure engineering background, you're coachable and excited to develop this side of your skillset.

  • You're proactive and organized. You don't wait to be told what needs to be done — you gather context, spot gaps, and get moving. You can hold multiple engineering workstreams in your head at once without losing sight of what matters most.

  • You build real credibility with engineers. Whether through a shared technical background or genuine curiosity about how things work, you earn trust with engineering teams, not by managing them from above, but by making their work easier and their path to delivery clearer.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and move with purpose. Shifting priorities don't throw you off — you adapt quickly and stay focused. You know when to push forward and when to slow down and get the right alignment before committing a team to a direction.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe autonomy and trust are what allow people to do their best, most innovative work — in a way that plays to their strengths and fits their life.

  • A connected team: We build a product that helps people connect, and we try to live that in how we work together too. Our remote-first, hybrid model supports a genuinely collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work hard to foster a sense of belonging — through Superhuman Circles (our team member resource groups for people with shared identities, including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents), and through programmes that celebrate our colleagues and the things we achieve together.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: We offer competitive pay alongside a benefits package that covers life care (including mental health support and risk benefits), generous and clearly defined time off, home office setup support, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: We'll help make your move to Berlin as smooth as possible. Our relocation package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in, and a relocation bonus to cover things like temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

Deine Mission

KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.

Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.

Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.

Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.

Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.

Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.

Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.

Dein Profil

Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.

KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.

Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.

Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.

KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.

Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.

Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.

Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.

Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

Benefits

  • 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht

  • 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe

  • 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit

  • 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen

  • 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket + option auf Anteile (VSOP)

  • 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren

  • 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens, top angebunden

  • 🎁 3.000 € p.a. Benefitsprogramm + Firmenhandy

 

Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Digital Plattform Automotive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
  • Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
  • Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
  • Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
  • Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.


Warum wir?

  • Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
  • Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
  • Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
  • Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
  • Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
  • Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
  • Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 


Unser Standort

Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria. 

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform Experience
Art Director
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Art Director based in France.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role shaping the complete visual identity of a multiplayer PvPvE shooter built in Unreal Engine.
You’ll own the artistic direction across characters, environments, animation, weapons, concept art, and UI/UX.
Working closely with creative, design, product, and technical teams, you’ll ensure every visual element feels cohesive and supports the player experience.
You’ll lead a multidisciplinary art team while remaining deeply involved in production and asset development.
The role combines high-level artistic vision with practical pipeline, workflow, and production ownership.
As the game moves toward Early Access and live content, you’ll help establish scalable processes for new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and ongoing updates.
You’ll join a distributed, self-managing team that values open collaboration, strong communication, and ambitious game development.


Accountabilities:

  • Own and define the overall art direction, visual identity, and creative standards across the game.

  • Direct the development of environment art, character and species design, animation, modeling, rigging, texturing, shader development, concept art, 2D assets, and UI/UX.

  • Establish clear artistic direction and provide regular feedback to ensure assets remain consistent, polished, and aligned with the game's identity.

  • Maintain a cohesive visual language across playable species, characters, environments, skins, cosmetics, and future content.

  • Partner closely with creative leadership, game designers, technical leaders, and product stakeholders to integrate art seamlessly with gameplay and game design.

  • Build and maintain effective 3D art pipelines within Unreal Engine and collaborate with technical teams to resolve production challenges.

  • Optimize artistic workflows and production processes to balance visual quality, development efficiency, and the pace required for live-service content.

  • Plan, initiate, execute, and control art production from early concepts through release-ready assets and post-launch updates.

  • Track milestones, production progress, and deliverables using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and support to the art team while keeping production aligned with schedules and quality expectations.

  • Contribute to the development of new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and other post-launch experiences.

  • Work cross-functionally to identify and resolve technical or production challenges that could affect artistic quality or delivery.

  • Help establish an environment where different art disciplines collaborate effectively within an agile and distributed production model.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in Art, Design, or a closely related discipline, complemented by substantial professional experience in game production.

    • At least 7 years of professional experience in the gaming industry, with exposure to the full development lifecycle from pre-production through live operations.

    • Proven experience directing or significantly contributing to at least one shipped AA or AAA game and the ability to support large-scale productions through release.

    • Hands-on experience creating stylized games with hand-painted textures and maintaining a distinctive, cohesive visual identity across characters and environments.

    • Strong portfolio demonstrating versatility across traditional art, 3D art, animation, UI/UX, and concept art, with consistently high standards of craftsmanship.

    • Strong knowledge of multidisciplinary art production, including 2D, 3D, animation, modeling, rigging, texturing, shaders, and UI/UX.

    • Professional proficiency in Maya and Substance Painter.

    • Strong experience with Unreal Engine and 3D art production pipelines.

    • Demonstrated ability to solve technical and production challenges collaboratively with engineering, design, and other cross-functional teams.

    • Proven ability to improve production workflows and increase both creative output and operational efficiency.

    • Strong project management and organizational skills, including experience tracking milestones and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.

    • Experience with Jira and Confluence; familiarity with Jira Advanced Roadmaps or Jira Plans is a significant advantage.

    • Excellent leadership, communication, mentoring, and stakeholder-management skills.

    • Ability to provide clear artistic direction while remaining hands-on and engaged in day-to-day production.

    • Comfortable working autonomously in a distributed, globally remote environment.

    • Strong collaborative mindset and ability to communicate effectively across creative and technical disciplines.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position with the flexibility to work from Europe.

      • Opportunity to lead the complete artistic direction of a multiplayer PvPvE shooter built in Unreal Engine.

      • Hands-on creative leadership role with substantial influence over the game's visual identity and production standards.

      • Opportunity to work across multiple art disciplines, including characters, environments, animation, weapons, concept art, and UI/UX.

      • Direct collaboration with creative, design, technical, and product leadership.

      • Opportunity to shape scalable art pipelines and workflows for Early Access and ongoing live-service content.

      • Distributed, self-managing team built around talent, communication, autonomy, and shared goals.

      • Open and collaborative international working environment.

      • Consultant engagement with Manager/Supervisor-level responsibilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are growing this team while it delivers, on a platform with real history, and some of what we currently believe will turn out to be wrong. The incumbent HR suites are consolidating and buying their way into this space, so the clock is real. 

The problem underneath it is genuinely unsolved. Nobody has built software that knows what a person needs to be able to do next week, teaches it in the few minutes they actually have, and observes whether it landed without asking them. Not the language apps, which have the habit but not the stakes. Not the platforms, which have the content but not the attention. Not the HR suites, which have the data but have never made anything a person voluntarily opens. 

If that sounds like a problem worth several years, we should talk. 

As our Senior Product Manager for the learner experience, you own the surface where learning actually happens, for the person actually doing it. It is the most visible product role in the company, because everything else in our strategy depends on somebody coming back on a Tuesday. Today weekly active learners sits close to one percent. That number is the job. 

Requirements

  • Own the learner surface end to end. Onboarding, what someone is offered next, how it arrives, and what we learn from what they did. 
  • Move us from a catalogue people browse to a product that pays attention. Personalisation here is a spectrum, not a feature: country and industry, company size, whether they reach us through their own LMS or directly, then company, department, team and finally the individual. A fifteen minute bus ride should be able to become seven minutes of audio and three quick questions, assembled for that person. 
  • Partner with our educational designers on how it reaches one person. They have decades of research behind how our content is built, in activities of two to eight minutes designed for habit formation. What is not yet settled is how those pieces compose into a path for one person, and you would be one of the people settling it. Your half is the one they cannot do on their own: how it reaches one specific person, on one specific day, on whatever device they have, and what to offer instead when something did not land. 
  • Own the measurement that makes it real. Weekly active learners is the number this role moves. There is a baseline. Setting the target with us, and owning the path to it, is part of the job. 
  • Treat mobile as a first class question rather than a port. Seven minutes attached to a real week is a phone experience far more often than a desk one. Whether that is a native client or something lighter is a genuine open decision with very different costs. 
  • Draw on a single library. Our own studio content, customer created content and content generated on the spot all sit together, and deciding what surfaces to whom is part of your job. 

This role is for you if you have 

  • A track record owning either a B2B2C product, where the buyer and the user are different people and the user did not choose you, or a consumer habit-formation product built to create usage rather than meet demand that already existed 
  • Evidence you have shipped personalisation, routing or recommendation work that measurably changed behaviour, and the scar tissue to know how often it does not 
  • Comfort on a platform that carries real history. You will build the new thing while the old thing earns the revenue, and sequencing that is part of the craft rather than an obstacle to it 
  • A habit of deciding. You gather input properly and then take the call, and you can say clearly what you are not doing and why 
  • A habit of working in the open. Drafts early, thinking visible, and you would rather be corrected on Tuesday than right on Friday 
  • A genuine interest in how people learn. You do not need a background in it, you do need to find it interesting, because you will work closely with people who have spent careers on it 
  • Comfort partnering with an embedded engineering manager on the team rather than managing engineers directly 

This role is not for you if 

  • You want a clean greenfield. That is a much easier engineering problem and a much worse bet, and it is not what this is 
  • You need the strategy finished before you start. It is being written now and you would be one of the people writing it 
  • You want to run the roadmap process. Product Operations owns that craft, this role owns the outcome 
  • You would rather own a feature area than a number 
  • You expect to set every priority yourself from day one. A leadership-set integration into the current platform is already on the roadmap when you arrive, yours to execute well, not to re-litigate 

Benefits

What we offer: 

Become part of the leader online training company in the European market, the benchmark in our sector, and help organisations thrive while you grow professionally at a trailblazing company with unstoppable momentum on an exciting growth journey even as others in the industry face challenges. 

  • 💰 Competitive salary and role-specific performance bonus because we value your contributions and reward your hard work. 
  • 🏖️ Paid time off – 25 days holiday. 
  • 🚆 Travel budget. 
  • 💻 Flexible work & tools – work in a supportive environment with the comforts you need, plus a laptop. 
  • 📈 Growth & development – unlimited access to GoodHabitz resources and MyAcademy to fuel your personal and professional growth. 
  • 🧠 Mental coaching – support from our partner,  to keep your mind in top shape. 
  • 🌍 Diverse & inclusive teams – work with colleagues from across Europe, bringing different cultures, perspectives, and ideas together. 
  • 🎉 Themed events & team-building – from creativity workshops to vitality socials, our events are full of energy and fun surprises. 
  • 🤝 Annual Do-Good Day – a fully paid day to do volunteer work, alone or with your team, supporting a cause you care about. 
  • 🛡️ Pension & insurance – disability and pension coverage for your long-term security. 

Ready to be part of our team?

jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.



Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
The Enterprise Solution Engineer is the technical heart of our Enterprise Sales motion. Working hand-in-hand with Account Executives, you'll own everything that happens before the contract is signed — technical discovery, tailored demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and the technical content of RFP/RFI and security responses.

This role is key to converting our largest, most complex prospects — dioceses, regional church bodies, and multi-parish organisations — by proving ChurchDesk meets their functional, security, and compliance requirements. Once a deal is won, you'll partner with the Enterprise Project Manager and CSMs to ensure a clean handover into rollout.

You'll be part of the Enterprise team, reporting to the Head of Enterprise, with monthly 1:1s and weekly check-ins.

About your new role

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects — digging into their current infrastructure, data, and workflows to understand where processes break down, not just what they say they want.

  • Design and build prospect-specific demo environments using their own terminology, structures, and use cases, showing exactly what daily life on ChurchDesk would look like.

  • Set up and run scoped proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments that validate security, performance, and functional fit ahead of contract signature.

  • Own the technical response to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits) as the central technical point of contact, working closely with the AE.

  • Secure the "technical win" by getting IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders to formally confirm ChurchDesk meets their requirements

  • Document technical commitments, constraints, and dependencies, and hand over a clean, accurate technical picture to the Enterprise Project Manager and CSM — ensuring what was sold is what gets delivered.

  • Act as the prospect's Trusted Technical Advisor and the deal's technical conscience throughout the sales cycle, giving honest and accurate answers even when it means surfacing limitations early.


Skills & Requirements

  • Proven track record in a pre-sales, Solutions Engineering, or technical sales role, ideally with enterprise or complex B2B deals.

  • Strong technical discovery skills — able to dig into infrastructure, data, and workflows to uncover real problems, not just stated requirements.

  • Hands-on experience building tailored product demos and running proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments.

  • Working knowledge of security, data protection, and compliance topics (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits), with the ability to answer RFP/RFI questionnaires accurately.

  • Confident in engaging directly with IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders, building technical credibility and trust.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with a high degree of integrity — able to translate findings into clear handovers and give honest answers, even when they surface limitations.

  • Fluent in German and English (spoken and written); based in or willing to relocate to Berlin for on-site work.

What We Offer

  • A role in a growing tech company where you can take on real responsibility, shape your own work, and learn a lot along the way.

  • Support to join relevant courses and webinars to build your technical and pre-sales skills with access to a dedicated Sales Coach.

  • Investing in your future – We contribute 20% toward your company pension scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge), because we're planning for the long run — with you.

  • 30 days of holiday – because rest matters.

  • A 37-hour working week – more balance, more time for yourself.

  • An open and honest feedback culture – growing together, learning from each other, communicating transparently.

  • A beautiful, modern office in the heart of Neukölln – central, vibrant, and well connected.

  • Fancy a change of scenery? Visit us in Copenhagen, Oslo, or Groningen – we cover your travel and accommodation so you can spend time with the team.

  • Unforgettable team experiences – from company events to trips to Croatia and Prague.

About ChurchDesk

At ChurchDesk, we believe that the church plays an important role in society. Our platform is used by thousands of congregations to organise their work, improve communication with members, reach more people, and unlock new ways of fundraising.
Our customers are part of one of the largest and oldest institutions in the world: the Church. It is undergoing significant change to prepare for the future — and we are here to support that transformation. For churches across Europe, it is crucial to work more efficiently and stay connected to their members and communities.

ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

We actively live our values in our daily work:

#challenge: We challenge ourselves — and our customers — to continuously improve. We work like a professional sports team: with ambition, discipline, and strong team spirit.

#dogoodbusiness: Doing good business is a marathon, not a sprint. It requires endurance, quality, and integrity — every single day.

#jointheride: The journey matters just as much as the destination. Be part of it, celebrate successes — and have fun! We value being together, especially in the office.

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas

  • Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.
  • Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

  • Accès à Moka.Care : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités.

Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne.

🎤 Processus de recrutement

Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail.

About the role:

As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional Head of Product - Clients. You will work closely with Florian Thiel, Christian Wöhlke, and the Product & Engineering teams of the tribe (3 domain teams in total). In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial leadership teams, owning topics critical to Upvest's product and business success.

Lead the clients tribe's product vision and strategy:

As Head of Product, you start leading one of the Clients tribe teams directly, while guiding the overarching strategy and success of the Clients Tribe and you start scaling yourself. Your challenge is to make our tools and workflows scale without lockstep headcount growth.. That means embedding intelligence and automation into every process, and exploring how agentic operations, AI agents handling operational workflows end to end, can take on work that today needs manual effort. You'll be the go-to voice for applied AI across our tooling, helping the business run efficiently and helping clients get to market faster, at lower cost and higher reliability.

Take tooling into its next stage:

You'll own the roadmap for Internal Tooling or Upfront, both key strategic product enablers for scaling the business, and drive it forward through OKRs, deciding where to push deeper automation, broaden coverage, or reimagine a workflow entirely. You'll work directly with the Engineering team, and stay close to the people the products serve, so every step forward is one that truly matters.


What you’ll do:

  • Autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. You fully own the product success of your team and function.

  • Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

  • Product Engineering culture, working closely with engineering counterparts guided by joint OKRs and a clear roadmap.

  • An exceptional team, combining impactful work with a relaxed, fun atmosphere and consistently high eNPS.

  • Continuous learning across investments, API products, and a state-of-the-art tech stack.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in Product Management, ideally with a focus on internal and/or external tooling. Financial services, compliance, or fintech experience is a big plus.

  • Proven people leadership of teams of 3+ people.

  • Firm grasp of UI/UX best practices; can ideate and prototype through lo-fi wireframes and collaborate closely with design.

  • Strong track record of taking initiative, owning outcomes, and bridging dependencies.

  • Be a sponge. You don't need to be a finance or investment expert, but you'll need to absorb complex topics quickly (subledger reconciliation, mutual fund trading flow) and apply strong product fundamentals.

  • Experience with agile software development, delivering features and outcomes consistently.

  • Comfortable with product toolkits such as Linear, Slite, Miro, and Figma.

  • Familiarity with API documentation standards and an interest in how AI agents consume APIs (MCP or similar) is a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, K4B
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK for Business, we're building the future of corporate travel technology — and the engineering teams behind it are at the heart of that mission. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead one or more agile engineering teams delivering software that helps companies and their travelers move smarter and with less friction, while playing a key role in shaping our growing engineering hub.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office at least 3 days per week.

In this role you will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery for one or more agile engineering teams, ensuring the team consistently ships high-quality software aligned with product and business objectives, measured against clear KPIs.

  • Define and drive the technical roadmap for your team's domain — collaborating with product managers and peer engineering leaders to translate business goals into a prioritized, executable plan.

  • Design and enforce engineering best practices across the team's codebase, including coding standards, testing strategies, observability, and clear Definition of Done criteria, raising the overall quality bar.

  • Lead hiring and performance management for a team of software engineers, owning the full employee lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding through career development, performance reviews, and promotions.

  • Coach and develop engineers at all levels — including senior engineers and emerging technical leads — through regular 1:1s, structured feedback, and deliberate career conversations that build the next generation of leaders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and peer engineering managers to plan and deliver complex, multi-team initiatives, ensuring clear alignment on scope, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Identify and remove delivery risks proactively — whether organizational, technical, or process-related — and drive improvements without waiting to be directed, keeping the team operating at high velocity.

  • Champion a culture of quality and continuous improvement, embedding practices such as blameless post-mortems, structured incident response, and iterative process refinement into the team's day-to-day rhythm.

  • Influence technical architecture across the team's domain by preparing and participating in design reviews, guiding architectural decisions, and ensuring systems are built for scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Help build and shape the engineering presence, contributing to local talent acquisition, onboarding, and team culture as part of the organization's strategic expansion of its engineering hub.

Please apply if you have:

  • 1+ years of experience leading engineering teams within the travel industry focused on supplier integrations (such as flights, hotels, or trains using Direct APIs, GDS, NDC, NDC[X]) or managing teams executing large-scale third-party content integrations.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role directly managing software engineers, and a proven track record of leading productive teams and shipping high-quality software in a fast-paced environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills considered.

  • A proven track record of ownership and innovation within a data-driven, results-oriented environment, along with the ability to rapidly learn and master new business domains.

  • A track record of steering organizational transformation, maximizing gains from agile methodologies, and fostering process optimization and innovation

  • Strong technical fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, and backend service architecture, with the ability to credibly guide architectural decisions and participate meaningfully in design reviews.

  • Demonstrated experience owning the full people management lifecycle — hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and promotions — with a genuine commitment to developing engineering talent.

  • Experience coaching and developing engineers at multiple levels, including senior engineers and emerging technical leads, through structured feedback, regular 1:1s, and deliberate career conversations.

  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies and the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices; comfortable driving process improvements within a sprint-based team.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision to both technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively across product, design, and engineering functions.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Hands-on experience with modern software development tooling — including version control systems (e.g., GitHub), issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and logging or observability platforms — and a demonstrated openness to adopting AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity.

  • Comfort working in a distributed, multilingual engineering organization with teams across multiple time zones and office locations.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; no specific certification is required.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

jobs.title: Partnership Manager
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ?

L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés.
Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité.
Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent.

L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes.

Ce poste est clé pour :

  • construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ;

  • accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ;

  • transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ;

  • sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ;

  • faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets.


Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés.

  • Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité.

  • Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux.

  • Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole.

  • En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact.

  • Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 %

  • Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation.

  • Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement.

  • Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification.

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée.


Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 %

  • Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres.

  • Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants.

  • Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux.

  • Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole.

  • Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain.

  • Travailler avec la responsable événementielle sur la préparation et l’organisation des événements prioritaires.

Initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets — 20 %

  • Co-construire avec l’équipe commerciale les initiatives destinées aux créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets : ciblage, calendrier, offres, contenus, événements et parcours d’activation.

  • Apporter une connaissance fine des parcours, besoins et signaux d’intention observés au sein de la communauté ANECS-CJEC.

  • Identifier les moments où Pennylane peut créer de la valeur : installation, reprise, structuration d’équipe, choix des outils, développement de nouvelles missions, vente, IA ou productivité.

  • Qualifier et transmettre les contacts et projets à fort potentiel à l’équipe commerciale selon un processus partagé.

  • Suivre, avec l’équipe commerciale, la contribution de ces initiatives au pipeline et au MRR attribuables au canal.


Stratégie d’activation, contenus et communauté — 20 %

  • Définir et animer une stratégie de communauté combinant présence physique, rendez-vous digitaux, contenus, email, social media et relais locaux.

  • Concevoir des formats utiles aux membres à chaque étape de leur parcours : réussite du diplôme, découverte des formes d’exercice, installation, reprise, développement ou modernisation d’un cabinet.

  • Développer des contenus et événements autour des enjeux qui transforment les cabinets : IA, productivité, nouvelles missions, organisation, recrutement, développement commercial et expérience client.

  • Formaliser les besoins, briefer l’équipe Enablement et coordonner la production des contenus.

  • Construire, segmenter et animer dans la durée une base de communauté qualifiée, dans le respect des règles de consentement et de gestion des données.


Pilotage de la performance et veille — 10 %

  • Suivre la couverture du réseau, les contacts générés, la qualité des leads, l’engagement de la communauté, les signaux détectés, le pipeline influencé, le MRR attribuable, le budget et le ROI.

  • Produire un reporting trimestriel présentant les résultats, les apprentissages terrain et les arbitrages de priorisation recommandés.

  • Assurer une veille sur les initiatives des concurrents auprès des jeunes professionnels de la profession comptable et proposer les réponses adaptées.

  • Identifier les territoires, sections et formats les plus performants afin de concentrer les moyens sur les actions à plus fort potentiel.


Profil recherché :
Tu disposes d’environ 4 à 6 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats B2B, l’animation de réseau, le community growth, le développement commercial indirect ou le marketing terrain à forte dimension business.
Tu as déjà évolué dans un environnement où il faut articuler une stratégie nationale avec des relais locaux : partenaires, antennes, ambassadeurs, clients et équipes internes. Tu sais transformer une présence terrain ou une communauté en dynamique mesurable de contacts, d’engagement et d’opportunités.
Tu apprécies particulièrement le terrain, les déplacements réguliers en région et les échanges directs avec des communautés professionnelles. Tu es autant à l’aise dans une relation avec un président de section que dans l’animation d’un atelier devant des membres, ou dans le suivi rigoureux d’une base de contacts et de ses signaux business.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Animation de réseau et de communauté: créer des relations durables avec des interlocuteurs variés, identifier les bons relais, animer une communauté et maintenir la continuité malgré les changements de personnes.

  • Appétence terrain: aimer aller au contact des professionnels dans les régions, participer à des événements et transformer une présence ponctuelle en relation durable.

  • Partenariats stratégiques: piloter une convention nationale, négocier des contreparties, gérer un budget et faire vivre un partenariat au-delà de sa signature.

  • Orientation business: identifier les actions, sections et événements les plus porteurs ; comprendre les besoins des membres et faire remonter les bons signaux à l’équipe commerciale.

  • Community growth: structurer une base de contacts, la segmenter, créer des séquences d’animation et développer l’engagement dans la durée.

  • Prise de parole et pédagogie: animer un atelier ou un webinaire, et rendre accessibles des sujets liés à la vente, l’IA, la productivité, les missions ou le développement du cabinet.

  • Pilotage par la donnée: suivre l’engagement, les signaux, la couverture territoriale, le pipeline, le MRR attribuable et le ROI des activations.

  • Coordination transverse: travailler efficacement avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

  • Autonomie: prendre en main un périmètre national, proposer un plan, l’exécuter et faire remonter les arbitrages nécessaires au bon moment.


Ce qui serait un plus, sans être obligatoire

  • Une connaissance de la profession comptable, du parcours vers le DEC ou de l’installation en cabinet.

  • Un réseau auprès de l’ANECS, du CJEC, des écoles de comptabilité-gestion, des incubateurs ou des réseaux de jeunes entrepreneurs.

  • Une expérience dans un environnement SaaS, fintech, outils de gestion ou accompagnement d’entrepreneurs.

  • La maîtrise de Salesforce, HubSpot, Brevo ou d’un outil comparable.

  • Une expérience de création de contenu B2B ou d’animation de réseaux sociaux professionnels.



Processus de recrutement :

  1. Échange de 30 minutes en visio avec un·e Business Recruiter.

  2. Entretien de 45 minutes avec Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable.

  3. Étude de cas d’une heure avec Cyril et Valentin Notteau, Head of Sales Accounting Firms, ou Claudia, Sales Team Lead — idéalement en présentiel.

  4. Entretien final de 45 minutes avec Édouard, Head of Sales.

  5. Team fit avec les principales équipes partenaires, en visio ou présentiel.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Codex
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities for Codex and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered software development workflows that improve how engineering teams plan, write, test, review, debug, and deliver software.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, workflow automations, and production accelerators—often using Codex as part of your own development process.
