jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
This role starts on the content platform, and the platform surface it serves is growing. The foundations of the company, identity and access, developer platform, data and the infrastructure everything runs on, are being invested in over the coming year. We are looking for someone whose curiosity does not stop at the edge of their own team, because the interesting problems here sit exactly where those layers meet. 

There is genuine ambiguity in this space right now, and a decision or two you would inherit that we have not finished making. We would rather tell you that than have you discover it in month two. The upside is that very little here is set, so the person who takes this shapes the layer everything else in the product is built on for the next several years. 

Requirements

  • Own the content services every surface depends on. The services and APIs that serve content to the learner surface, the admin surface and everything we build next, plus the delivery path including CDN and video, and file and asset storage. 
  • Own the structural contract. How content is stored, versioned and served so it can be reused and assembled differently for different customers. This is a schema and interface problem before it is a tooling problem, and your measure is whether the contract other teams build against is clear, stable and safe to change. 
  • Own multi tenant separation. Making sure one customer’s content and branding stay theirs. The tenancy model needs a decision and an owner, and that will be one of your first real pieces of work. 
  • Own access, entitlements and data residency. Who can reach what, where data lives, and what we are able to commit to contractually. 
  • Own performance and cost per tenant. If this layer is slow, everything is slow. If it is expensive, it is expensive everywhere. 
  • Carry the platform half of a migration already in flight. We are moving off an incumbent content tool while the current system keeps earning. Sequencing that is the real work, and the order matters more than the ambition. 
  • Own the non functional questions that show up in deals. A meaningful share of our deals slow down in security and compliance review rather than in the pitch, and that is a product problem with a revenue number attached. 

This role is for you if you have:

  • Experience with content management as a product, whether that is a CMS, a DAM, a headless content platform or a structured content system at scale. This is our primary preference. 
  • Experience owning platform or infrastructure adjacent product, where success was measured in what other teams could build rather than in features a customer names. 
  • Enough technical depth to be useful and the honesty to say where you are not. You can read an architecture proposal, ask the question that unpicks it, and tell the difference between a researched answer and a fluent one. 
  • The ability to hold your own with senior engineers, infrastructure engineers and security specialists. Not as a peer on implementation, but well enough that a remediation estimate or a tenancy design does not go unchallenged. A previous career as an engineer is a real advantage and not a requirement. 
  • A habit of thinking in seams. Where systems meet, what a contract between them should guarantee, and how to keep a decision reversible rather than walking through a one way door. 
  • The ability to sequence. We are modernising a platform that carries real history while it keeps earning, and the order matters more than the ambition. 
  • Writing. Decisions, tradeoffs and the reasoning behind them, in a way an engineer and an executive can both act on. 
  • Nice to have, and genuinely useful: depth in AI and personalisation, or in infrastructure. Either one compounds with this role, and we are not expecting both. 

This role is not for you if:

  • You want to be a delivery manager for the engineers. They are strong and they do not need coordinating. They need decisions and clarity about what matters. 
  • You want to own the authoring and editorial experience itself. A colleague owns that, you will work closely with them, and drawing the seam between you well is part of the job. 
  • You want to run a rewrite programme. Foundations serve outcomes, and a foundation with no customer outcome attached does not get funded here and should not. 
  • You need the surrounding decisions settled before you arrive. 

Benefits

What we offer: 

Become part of the leader online training company in the European market, the benchmark in our sector, and help organisations thrive while you grow professionally at a trailblazing company with unstoppable momentum on an exciting growth journey even as others in the industry face challenges. 

  • 💰 Competitive salary and role-specific performance bonus because we value your contributions and reward your hard work. 
  • 🏖️ Paid time off – 25 days holiday. 
  • 🚆 Travel budget. 
  • 💻 Flexible work & tools – work in a supportive environment with the comforts you need, plus a laptop. 
  • 📈 Growth & development – unlimited access to GoodHabitz resources and MyAcademy to fuel your personal and professional growth. 
  • 🧠 Mental coaching – support from our partner,  to keep your mind in top shape. 
  • 🌍 Diverse & inclusive teams – work with colleagues from across Europe, bringing different cultures, perspectives, and ideas together. 
  • 🎉 Themed events & team-building – from creativity workshops to vitality socials, our events are full of energy and fun surprises. 
  • 🤝 Annual Do-Good Day – a fully paid day to do volunteer work, alone or with your team, supporting a cause you care about. 
  • 🛡️ Pension & insurance – disability and pension coverage for your long-term security. 

Ready to be part of our team?

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.
    • Why Join our Account Management Team:
     
    At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.
     
    This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership.

    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

jobs.title: Strategic Tech Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

À propos du rôle

Chez Pennylane, les partenariats jouent un rôle clé dans notre capacité à accompagner les cabinets comptables et leurs clients avec une expérience financière toujours plus intégrée.

En tant que Strategic Partnerships Manager, vous serez responsable du développement d’un portefeuille resserré de partenaires stratégiques dans plusieurs catégories de produits. Votre mission sera de transformer ces partenariats en véritables leviers de croissance, en combinant animation commerciale, adoption produit et développement de notre écosystème.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success afin d’aligner les intérêts de Pennylane et de ses partenaires, et de générer une croissance durable chez nos clients communs.

Vos responsabilités

  1. Animer et développer un portefeuille de partenaires stratégiques

  • Gérer un portefeuille de 20 à 30 partenaires technologiques.

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les interlocuteurs clés de vos partenaires : équipes commerciales, marketing, produit, direction et customer success.

  • Définir, avec chaque partenaire, une stratégie de développement adaptée à son potentiel, à son niveau de maturité et à ses priorités business.

  • Mettre en place des rituels de pilotage réguliers : business reviews, points d’avancement, plans d’action et suivi des engagements réciproques.

  • Identifier les opportunités d’upsell, de cross-sell et d’élargissement de la collaboration.

  1. Générer du business grâce au co-selling

  • Co-construire et exécuter des business plans annuels avec les partenaires prioritaires.

  • Développer des motions de co-selling efficaces entre les équipes commerciales de Pennylane et celles de nos partenaires.

  • Identifier, qualifier et faire progresser les opportunités commerciales issues de l’écosystème partenaire.

  • Structurer les processus de génération, de partage et de suivi des leads et opportunités.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Sales pour accélérer la conversion des opportunités et maximiser le MRR généré.

  • Organiser des actions commerciales communes : campagnes ciblées, événements, webinars, contenus ou opérations de prospection conjointes.

  1. Accélérer l’adoption produit et l’usage chez les clients communs

  • Suivre la santé des intégrations et des parcours communs entre Pennylane et ses partenaires.

  • Stimuler l’adoption de nos intégrations et l’augmentation du nombre d’utilisateurs actifs chez les clients communs.

  • Identifier les freins à l’activation, à l’usage ou à la rétention, puis coordonner les plans d’action avec les équipes concernées.

  • Mettre en place des indicateurs de suivi de l’usage et partager régulièrement les analyses avec les partenaires.

  • Contribuer à améliorer l’expérience client sur l’ensemble du parcours, de l’acquisition à l’utilisation quotidienne des solutions connectées.

  1. Devenir l’expert de vos catégories de produits

  • Développer une compréhension approfondie des catégories de produits et des marchés couverts.

  • Devenir le référent interne et externe sur les acteurs, tendances, cas d’usage et dynamiques concurrentielles de votre périmètre.

  • Comprendre la stratégie produit et commerciale de chaque partenaire afin d’identifier les opportunités d’alignement avec Pennylane.

  • Faire remonter les besoins et retours du marché aux équipes Product, Engineering et Marketing.

  • Contribuer à prioriser les évolutions d’intégration et les initiatives communes avec les partenaires.

  • Aider les équipes internes à mieux comprendre la valeur et le positionnement des solutions partenaires.

  1. Mener une chasse stratégique ciblée

  • Cartographier l’écosystème français et identifier les acteurs stratégiques encore absents de notre portefeuille.

  • Qualifier les partenaires présentant le plus fort potentiel pour Pennylane, nos clients et notre stratégie produit.

  • Construire des approches d’engagement personnalisées auprès de ces acteurs.

  • Négocier et signer de nouveaux partenariats à fort impact.

  • Développer progressivement ces nouvelles relations jusqu’à leur activation commerciale et produit.

Vos indicateurs de performance

  • Croissance du MRR sourced et influenced sur vos catégories de produits.

  • Nombre d’utilisateurs actifs connectés via les intégrations partenaires.

  • Taux d’adoption et d’utilisation des intégrations chez les clients communs.

  • Taux de rétention, notamment la Net Revenue Retention, des clients utilisant les intégrations dédiées.

  • Nombre de partenaires accompagnés avec succès du Tier Silver au Tier Gold.

  • Contribution des partenaires aux objectifs de croissance de Pennylane.

  • Nombre de nouveaux partenaires stratégiques signés et activés.

  • Satisfaction et niveau d’engagement des partenaires prioritaires.

Le profil recherché

  • Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en partenariats stratégiques, business development, account management ou écosystème SaaS.

  • Vous avez déjà géré des portefeuilles de partenaires ou de comptes stratégiques avec des objectifs de croissance mesurables.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et équipes : Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success et Direction.

  • Vous savez construire une relation de confiance tout en gardant une forte orientation business et résultats.

  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension des mécanismes de co-selling, de génération de leads et de développement commercial indirect.

  • Vous êtes capable de structurer un plan d’action, de prioriser vos efforts et de piloter plusieurs initiatives en parallèle.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données et le suivi de KPIs commerciaux et produit.

  • Vous savez évoluer dans des contextes complexes, avec des cycles de décision parfois longs et plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Vous avez d’excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de présentation.

  • Vous êtes fluent en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Les qualités qui feront la différence

  • Orientation résultats : vous aimez transformer une relation partenaire en impact concret pour le business.

  • Esprit stratégique : vous savez prendre de la hauteur, identifier les bons leviers et construire une vision commune.

  • Leadership transversal : vous êtes capable d’embarquer des équipes sans lien hiérarchique direct.

  • Culture produit : vous aimez comprendre les usages, les intégrations et les problématiques des utilisateurs.

  • Rigueur et autonomie : vous structurez votre activité et assurez un suivi fiable de vos engagements.

  • Sens du collectif : vous privilégiez la collaboration et cherchez à construire des relations durables, en interne comme en externe.

  • Curiosité sectorielle : vous aimez comprendre un marché, ses acteurs et ses évolutions.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien RH avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 30 mins

  2. Entretien Manager avec avec Chloé - Partner Team Lead - Connectivity - 45 mins

  3. Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Chloé + 1 membre de l'équipe - 1h

  4. Last Round avec Arnaud - General Manager Connectivity - 45-mins

  5. Team Fit avec l'équipe Tech partnerships + Marketing - 30 mins

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ?

🌴 Quel que soit votre lieu de travail, vous bénéficierez de 25 jours de congés payés par Pennylane

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

📈 Vous recevrez des actions de l’entreprise pour profiter d’une part de la réussite que vous construisez avec nous

🏡 Vous disposerez d’un budget pour transformer votre domicile en un espace de travail plus confortable, ainsi que d’une allocation mensuelle pour travailler dans un espace de coworking quand vous le souhaitez

⛹️ Grâce à notre partenaire Gymlib, vous aurez accès à 8 000 salles de sport en Europe et à plus de 300 activités liées au bien-être

🇬🇧 Vous aurez accès à Busuu pour perfectionner votre anglais ou votre français

💻 Vous disposerez des derniers équipements Apple

🏢 En fonction des équipes et des exigences du poste, vous pourrez travailler à distance


Si vous êtes basé en France, vous bénéficierez d’un contrat de travail français conforme à la réglementation française, en plus des avantages suivants : 6 à 12 jours de RTT, 5 semaines de congés payés, des crédits repas (Swile), une couverture santé Alan Blue et des événements réguliers dans les villes où les Pennylaners sont les plus nombreux (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Nous travaillons à étendre ces derniers avantages à nos collaborateurs basés hors de France, mais cela peut s’avérer plus complexe selon les pays.

 

Informations importantes pour les candidats

 

Les tentatives d’escroquerie à l’embauche sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilants lors de vos échanges.

Postulez uniquement via les canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres d’emploi publiées sur nos plateformes officielles (site Carrières, pages partenaires officielles).

Si une telle demande vous est adressée, il s’agit d’une tentative de fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas y répondre et à nous la signaler immédiatement.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in France.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.
    • Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers.
    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.
    • Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels.
    • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship.
    • Curiosity about emerging developments in AI, machine learning, and scientific research.
    • Strong attention to accuracy, fact-checking, and technical detail.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with researchers, designers, and multimedia professionals.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they are based.

      • Benefits:

      • Ongoing contract engagement with opportunities for professional growth and potential transition to a full-time position.

      • High degree of ownership over research, editorial projects, and storytelling formats.
      • Opportunities to work on impactful projects at the forefront of AI and machine learning.

Your mission

You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us!

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive Swiss Markets - Zurich, Barcelona, Munich or Berlin
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We seek an ambitious and motivated candidate to join as a Senior Sales Executive DACH and support the Sales team. In this role, you will report to the Sales Manager and be instrumental in achieving our ambitious goals within the Swiss Market.

Ultimately, you’ll help us meet and surpass business expectations and contribute to our company’s rapid growth. The ideal person has a pioneering mindset, is hungry, perseverant, and focused, and is not afraid to hit the phone to engage with new customers.

We’ll value someone with a curious mind who is interested in bringing their great Perk experience to a new role. Perfect for a person who is looking to have a significant impact on a scaling sales organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Focus on mid to large enterprise companies (250 - 5000+ employees) headquartered in Switzerland

  • Take on additional responsibility within the team, identify and take ownership and drive projects that bring value to the wider business:

  • Generate new clients for our outstanding travel and spend technology

  • Own the entire sales process from the first touchpoint, present product demos to potential clients, negotiate and do the follow-up until closing the deal;

  • Understand the needs of our target prospects and articulate the value that Perk provides. Follow the entire sales cycle;

  • Stay up-to-date with new features and product launches;

  • Help define and establish best practices together with the broader team;

  • Monitor and report on sales performance analytics and forecasts;

  • Mastering to consult conservative clients into digital opportunities;

  • Owning the conversations between C level stakeholders in finance, procurement, IT, and travel management;

  • Evaluate the existing infrastructure of the clients and consult the individual SaaS solutions;

  • Suggest innovative upsell / partner ideas to increase sales and improve customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Being a native German speaker and fluent in English is a must;

  • Fluency in French is a plus

  • Possess excellent communication, presentation, and public speaking skills;

  • Be hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Be able to work as an individual contributor, but remember you are part of a team;

  • Be a customer-centric mindset.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins Virtual or IRL if possible

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - In-person Interview

  • Values Interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Team Lead DACH
jobs.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is predicted to cost the world $10.5 trillion annually by 2025 - we invite you to be part of the solution!

Your mission:
Are you a people-person who thrives on helping others grow and succeed? Do you enjoy coaching, sharing your knowledge, and setting your peers up for success? This newly created role offers the opportunity to build our first Enterprise focused Customer Success team for DACH. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Customer Success, you’ll drive team performance through coaching, development, and clear accountability, while ensuring alignment with segment, regional and global strategy. You’ll play a key role in building a strong CSM culture, enabling your team to deliver measurable impact for our largest customers. All of this while contributing to one of the most exciting industries in digitalisation — helping to make the internet a little bit safer, together with a highly driven team.

Here's how you'll make a difference:
• Lead, guide, and support a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers, driving performance against key metrics (gross retention, net revenue retention, and expansion) across a portfolio of high-value, strategic accounts
• Build and own the enterprise account strategy including risk management, expansion planning, and executive sponsorship programs for your team's book of business
• Coach your team on navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying and renewal environments, including negotiation strategy and commercial structuring for high-ARR contracts
• Personally engage with C-level and senior stakeholders on strategic accounts to build executive relationships, resolve escalations, and reinforce long-term partnership value
• Clearly communicate company vision, strategy, and goals within your team, translating them into account-level execution
• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Partner leadership to ensure a cohesive enterprise/regional go-to-market strategy
• Spot knowledge gaps and training needs, setting your team up for success while identifying process and tooling improvements to scale enterprise-grade delivery
• Analyze account health data and portfolio trends to shape targeted strategies, risk mitigation plans, and expansion initiatives across the Enterprise segment
• Represent the voice of the enterprise customer internally, ensuring insights from strategic accounts inform product, process, and go-to-market decisions
• Cultivate advocacy at the executive level references, case studies, and speaking opportunities turning strategic accounts into brand champions

What makes you a great fit:
• 10+ years Customer Success experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, with meaningful time managing enterprise or strategic accounts
• 3+ years leading Enterprise Customer Success teams, ideally with exposure to complex or multi-stakeholder account portfolios
• Demonstrated ability to build relationships with and influence senior/C-level stakeholders, both externally and internally
• Commercial acumen, comfortable with quantifying ROI/value for large accounts
• Strong track record of retention and expansion within complex, multi-threaded accounts
• Naturally curious, skilled at uncovering stakeholders' goals, politics, and buying dynamics beyond the obvious
• Resilience and grit, able to stay effective and solution-oriented navigating escalations, ambiguity, and high-stakes conversations
• Confident communicator and presenter, capable of holding a room with senior internal and external stakeholders
• Empathetic and people-oriented, able to build trust-based relationships internally and externally while motivating and inspiring others
• Happy to travel ~30% of the time for customer onsites and industry events
• Fluent in English and German
• Based in Cologne or Berlin within a reasonable commute to our office

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and Financial support: Open Up, Corporate Discounts

  • Coming together for moments that matter: annual company off-site, team events, local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Learning & Development Allowance, Tech Equipment, Referral Bonuses, Dog Friendly HQ



*Perks and Benefits listed above are for full-time employees and can vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample; you’ll learn about more benefits offered during the interview process

About Us
At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.
Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.
If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
jobs.description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
  • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.
  • Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. 
  • Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet.

Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Programm Management, Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und bist für unsere Kunden ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner rund um Testing und Qualitätssicherung.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Test Manager bei NELTA und gestalte mit uns Qualität in anspruchsvollen IT-Projekten.

jobs.description:

Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Are you passionate about turning data into action?

We’re seeking an experienced Senior Product Analytics Engineer to join our product organization and help shape the future of SoSafe’s data-informed decision-making. In one of Europe’s fastest-growing cybersecurity scale-ups, you will play a key role in translating complex data into clear insights that directly influence product strategy, user experience, and business growth. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to uncover opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure we’re building the right solutions and positioning them effectively for our users and customers.

UK, Ireland, or Portugal. Candidates must have work authorization in one of these countries. Office access available in London, Dublin, and Lisbon.

  • Own product analytics across the different product lines: define, track success metrics and respective targets while ensuring alignment with overall Product and Company strategy.

  • Influence Decision-Making: Use a deep understanding of our product, users, and business to craft compelling data stories that guide product leaders in critical decisions.

  • Build reusable, scalable data products: collaborate with other engineers in developing data products that enable self-service analytics and democratize data access.

  • Build a governed self-service layer: define practices on event instrumentation & taxonomy for our event-driven architecture and self-service analytics tooling and enable Product and GTM peers on event instrumentation and insight generation.

  • Drive Data Literacy: Evangelize the use of data and empower teams to self-serve insights by increasing data literacy through enablement and close partnership.

  • Work AI-native: Continuously evaluate where LLMs and AI tooling can compress your workflow — from query generation to dashboard building to insight synthesis — and apply them deliberately to increase the speed and scope of what you and the team deliver.

  • Work cross-functionally with GTM: connect product usage to commercial outcomes (win/loss, expansion, renewal) and scale repeatable analyses/automations.

What makes you a great fit:

  • 5+ years of experience in an data analytics/ analytics engineering/ data science role, with significant experience directly supporting product teams in B2B companies.

  • Expert in the fundamentals of product analytics including building metric trees, experimentation, user activity & retention analytics, funnels & customer segmentation.

  • Excellent SQL skills, and strong experience using DBT for data transformations. Experience coding in Python is also relevant. Strong experience with data modelling for scale and reusability.

  • Demonstrated experience using current LLM offering to meaningfully improve your own or your team's workflows or results — with concrete examples of what you automated, sped up, or offloaded, and the measurable impact it had.

  • Ability to combine curiosity and ambition with a strategic mindset — continuously seeking better ways to deliver impact, scale insights, and drive business outcomes.

  • Experience working with event-based tracking data for web or mobile, and hands-on experience with a behavioral analytics tool e.g. Amplitude, Heap, MixPanel etc.

  • Ability to communicate findings succinctly and clearly to a wide variety of stakeholders so that they can draw conclusions quickly and make rapid decisions.

  • Relevant experience in cross-functional projects with GTM: proven valuable projects with Customer Success, RevOps or Product Marketing (e.g., churn early-warning, renewal/expansion predictors, win-loss usage mapping).

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample- you'll learn more during the interview process.

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.title: Responsable des Affaires Réglementaires H/F
jobs.description:
En tant que Responsable des Affaires Réglementaires, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en œuvre et l'exécution de la stratégie réglementaire pour notre portefeuille innovant de dispositifs médicaux, avec un fort accent sur les Logiciels en tant que Dispositif Médical (SaMD).

Rattaché(e) au VP Affaires Réglementaires, vous contribuerez à l'obtention et au maintien des approbations réglementaires dans le monde entier tout en veillant au respect continu des réglementations applicables. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires comprenant les départements Clinique, Qualité, R&D, Produit et Marketing.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Mettre en œuvre la stratégie réglementaire définie par le VP Affaires Réglementaires.

  • Définir et maintenir l'utilisation prévue du produit, les indications d'utilisation, l'étiquetage et la documentation associée.

  • Soutenir la stratégie de classification réglementaire et déterminer les voies réglementaires appropriées sur les marchés mondiaux.

  • Diriger et contribuer à la préparation, à la soumission et au maintien des dossiers réglementaires, y compris les activités de soumission à la FDA et de marquage CE.

  • Examiner et approuver la documentation technique clé, notamment :

    • Spécifications et exigences du produit

    • Documentation de gestion des risques

    • Documentation de vérification et de validation

    • Étiquetage du produit et documentation utilisateur

  • Évaluer les changements de produit et de processus pour déterminer l'impact réglementaire et les actions réglementaires requises.

  • Maintenir le suivi des politiques réglementaires et des exigences réglementaires.

  • Gérer et maintenir les données dans les bases de données réglementaires telles que la Liste des Dispositifs de la FDA, EUDAMED et ClinicalTrials.gov.

  • Surveiller les changements dans le paysage réglementaire et évaluer leur impact sur l'entreprise et le portefeuille de produits.

  • Agir en tant que Délégué PRRC (Personne Responsable de la Conformité Réglementaire) conformément au RDM 2017/745.

  • Agir en tant que Délégué Responsable de la Matériovigilance.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Contribuer à des technologies médicales innovantes alimentées par l'IA.

  • Travailler sur des produits ayant un impact direct sur les soins aux patients.

  • Rejoindre un environnement hautement collaboratif, international et pluridisciplinaire.

  • Jouer un rôle clé dans les soumissions réglementaires mondiales et les stratégies d'accès au marché.


Median Technologies s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, de l'égalité des genres et de l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.


Formation

  • Master ou Doctorat en Sciences Biologiques, Sciences Médicales ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Affaires Réglementaires dans les Dispositifs Médicaux, les Dispositifs Médicaux de Diagnostic In Vitro (IVD) et/ou les Logiciels en tant que Dispositif Médical (SaMD).

  • Expérience dans la définition de l'utilisation prévue, des indications d'utilisation et de la documentation d'étiquetage du produit.

  • Expérience pratique dans la préparation et la soumission de dossiers réglementaires pour :

    • Soumissions à la FDA américaine

    • Marquage CE selon les réglementations de l'UE

jobs.title: POST-DOCTORANT.E / INGENIEUR.E : Conception de systèmes et d’interfaces capteurs et énergie pour les systèmes électroniques étirables autonomes – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que Concepteur(trice) de Systèmes Etirables Autonomes, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté au département électronique flexible. Au sein de ce département vous conjuguez passion scientifique et goût pour l’innovation.

Au sein du Centre Microélectronique de Provence, le département FEL mène ses recherches dans le domaine de l'électronique flexible et étirable, pour des applications dédiées aux objets "wearable" et au « monitoring » environnemental. La conception de systèmes complets, du capteur au module de de communication, en fonction des contraintes énergétiques et environnementales est un élément essentiel permettant la réalisation de prototypes compatibles avec les cas d'usages étudiés.

Vous aurez pour mission principale, à partir du savoir-faire du département de développer l'expertise électronique dans le domaine des objets autonomes / autoalimentés pour le monitoring environnemental (Projet Hydrademo) et des interfaces "wearable" pour la perception augmentée( Projet flexeo3D). Par ailleurs, vous contribuerez au développement de modules de formation en mastère spécialisé, dans le cadre du programme EDU4chip

  ·           Vous accompagnez le développement de systèmes autonomes dans le cadre de différents projets du département

·           Vous contribuez au montage à la dispense d'un module d ’enseignement en conception de systèmes autonomes (25h) à destination des étudiants du mastère spécialisé « Concepteur de Circuits Microélectroniques »  

·           Vous assurez la conception et la réalisation des interfaces spécifiques capteurs et énergie pour nos démonstrateurs systèmes

·           Vous participez à la réalisation de prototypes innovants et à leur test en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de recherche

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

·      Titulaire d’un Diplôme de doctorat ou d’ingénieur ou équivalent en électronique

·      Junior accepté : oui si expérience pertinente lors des stages

 

En outre, vous possédez :

•      Une expérience dans le développement de systèmes à microcontrôleurs

•      Une expérience pratique de la conception et de la réalisation des cartes électroniques

•      De bonnes connaissances en électronique analogique

•      La connaissance de procédés d’intégration électronique sur support flexible serait un plus

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

•           Votre sens pratique et votre esprit « maker »

•           Votre capacité à évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif de recherche et développement

•           Votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

  • Fokus auf Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen: Du stehst unseren vermögenden Bestandskund:innen bei allen Fragen rund um das Thema Vermögensverwaltung und Marktgeschehen kompetent und verlässlich zur Seite.   • Teil eines innovativen Teams sein: Du übermittelst nicht nur das Feedback unserer Kund:innen, sondern bringst auch eigene Impulse in die Teams für Sales, Marketing, Operations und Tech ein. So gestaltest du aktiv die externe Kommunikation mit und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Plattformen im Sinne unseres Klientels bei.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Background: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung (idealerweise Bankausbildung) oder ein erfolgreich absolviertes Studium (bevorzugt im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen).

Dabei konntest du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte und verschiedene Anlageklassen entwickeln. Du arbeitest selbstständig, setzt die richtigen Prioritäten und begegnest Herausforderungen proaktiv mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität. Du hast keine Schwierigkeiten damit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Bestleistungen abzurufen.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

 

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

 

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

About aiPTO

aiPTO is a TechBio startup spun off from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), taking on one of medicine's hardest problems: brain cancer. We are building a disruptive approach — pairing next-generation patient-derived living tumor with fit-for-purpose virtual-tumor AI models. By recreating a patient's tumor biology in vitro and decoding it in silico, we aim to revolutionize brain cancer drug discovery and precision medicine. More details can be found on our publications (Individualized patient tumor organoids faithfully preserve human brain tumor ecosystems and predict patient response to therapy, DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aipto/).

The project

aiPTO has been selected as the data and AI partner of a newly funded Horizon Europe consortium that unites world-class neuro-oncologists, pathologists and drug-discovery pioneers across Europe. Together we are generating patient profiles of unprecedented depth: multi-omics, high-resolution digital pathology, 3D imaging and longitudinal clinical records, alongside single-cell drug-perturbation data from patient-derived organoids.

As the first member of our Heidelberg hub, you will build the data engine that turns these massive, disparate streams into AI-ready data atlas — the foundation for virtual tumor models and agentic systems designed to predict patient-specific drug response, decode resistance and reveal drug mechanisms.

What you will do

  • Architect the scientific data engine: design, build and scale the infrastructure that unifies multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, digital pathology, radiological imaging and clinical data

  • Make data AI-ready: harmonise and standardise multimodal datasets for deep-learning models and agentic workflows, working hand-in-hand with our machine-learning and computer-vision scientists

  • Bridge the disciplines: be the link between wet-lab researchers, clinical oncologists and IT scientists, translating biological questions into data schemas

  • Own rigour and compliance: implement biomedical metadata standards and GDPR-grade governance for sensitive patient data

What you bring

  • PhD, or MSc with 2+ years of experience, in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, biomedical engineering or a related quantitative field

  • Demonstrated mastery in structuring and integrating complex biological or clinical datasets; hands-on experience with real-world patient data is a strong plus

  • Depth in at least one modality — multi-omics, spatial biology, digital pathology or medical imaging — and familiarity with biomedical metadata standards

  • Advanced Python and modern software-engineering practice; experience with database architecture, data tooling for biological workflows or AI coding assistants is highly valued

  • A pioneering mindset: self-driven, curious and motivated by turning advanced technology into real patient impact in an agile startup

Why join aiPTO

  • Direct patient impact: your work feeds models built for an aggressive cancer with few options — every well-structured dataset moves us closer to patient-matched therapy

  • Founding leadership: as our first Heidelberg team member you shape the technology stack, the architecture and the hub

  • World-class network: close collaboration with DKFZ, leading European clinical centres and international consortium partners

  • Package and trajectory: competitive compensation, hybrid working, and a career path that accelerates as aiPTO scales
